description:
Option B of the fz-yh5.8 page (https://claude.ai/artifact/MyYNgFG8V8uVvErvPXamku): the library states the guard. Guard plans are made per literal arity, and fz_function_arity is a projection, so a type test asks about the value without demanding a boxed callable.

Same defect as fz-yh5.8: OTP's :lists.foldl guard 'when is_function(F, 2)' sends Enum.reduce's reducer across the boxed seam (+11.8% distiller requests, mue.44 evidence). fz-yh5.8 builds option A, the guard-domain table entry. The user chose (2026-11-21) to build both as separate PRs so they can be compared, and will then pick one; the other PR closes unmerged.

Note from the user: Elixir supports tuple_size in guards; fz has not got there yet. It is not out of scope as a language feature.

Owner: Callables.
title: An is_function(f, n) guard is planned from the library, with fz_function_arity as a projection (option B)
